items.description: On the SPO list there is a column called isLatest or something similar to that. It is a boolean yes/no column. items.title: User Interface Improvement
items.description: This feature focuses on improving the overall usability, readability, and visual consistency of the Enterprise TDR Power App. Enhancements will ensure the interface aligns with current VCDS standards, supports bilingual users, and provides a better user experience across desktop and mobile devices.

items.title: Functional Requirements
items.description: This feature captures additional high-value functional and usability enhancements to the Enterprise TDR application. The improvements focus on approval routing, blanket travel efficiencies, traveller management, cost accuracy, transmittal workflows, and mailbox reliability. These changes enhance the overall user experience, reduce manual workload, and improve data consistency across L1/L2 organizations.

items.title: Blanket Travel Improvements
items.description: Entering multiple trips under a Blanket Travel Authorization (BTA) is repetitive and time-consuming. Add an option to specify the number of occurrences per trip to automatically multiply the cost estimates.
items.assigned: Gabriel, Robel VCDS Gp HQ VCEMD QG Gp Defence365

items.title: Support multiple travel objectives and virtual prescence
items.description: Allow users to assign different travel objectives to individual trips within a single Travel Plan, as some trips may serve different purposes (e.g., multiple L2 conferences).
items.assigned: Martin, Perry VCDS Gp HQ VCEMD QG Gp Defence365

items.title: Copy Request Function
items.description: Add options to copy or reference existing TDRs to simplify creating similar or supplemental trips.
items.assigned: Martin, Perry VCDS Gp HQ VCEMD QG Gp Defence365

items.title: New TDR details
items.description: Add fields to capture whether travel was business planned and within the travel ceiling, to provide better visibility on justification.
items.assigned: Martin, Perry VCDS Gp HQ VCEMD QG Gp Defence365

items.title: Preparation for L1 Commander Approvals
items.description: Add a new transmittal workflow that allows certain L1 Commands to bypass the VCDS Compt for direct approval routing.
items.assigned: Ninhi, Shella VCDS Gp HQ VCEMD QG Gp Defence365

items.title: Executive Summary – Flight Cost
items.description: Ensure consistency by updating the “Flight Cost” label in email notifications to “Transportation Cost.”
items.assigned: Martin, Perry VCDS Gp HQ VCEMD QG Gp Defence365

items.title: Support multiple foreign currencies
items.description: Allow users to enter and calculate cost estimates in multiple currencies for multi-leg trips.
items.assigned: Call, Zachary VCDS Gp HQ VCEMD QG Gp Defence365

items.title: Transmittal Sheet Improvements
items.description: Enhance the transmittal sheet for easier management and clearer feedback when sending TDRs.
items.assigned: Isaac, Thamizh VCDS Gp HQ VCEMD QG Gp Defence365

items.title: Edit functionality
items.description: Allow L2 Comptrollers (and other authorized users) to edit TDRs prior to EIA signature to reduce delays and back-and-forth with originators.
items.assigned: Martin, Perry VCDS Gp HQ VCEMD QG Gp Defence365

items.title: Approval of TDR in Notification Email
items.description: Explore enabling TDR approval directly from the notification email to simplify the approval process.
items.assigned: Martin, Perry VCDS Gp HQ VCEMD QG Gp Defence365

items.title: Default City limit rate, meals & incidental values based on NJC – Difficult LoE
items.description: Automatically populate daily rates and allowances using official NJC and PSPC data based on the destination city and country.

items.title: Search functionality
items.description: Allow users to quickly locate specific requests using the TDR ID in both the Dashboard and Pending Actions.
items.assigned: Call, Zachary VCDS Gp HQ VCEMD QG Gp Defence365

items.title: Custom L2 transmittal sheets
items.description: Allow each L2 Comptroller to use a customized transmittal sheet with pre-populated values for annual updates.

items.title: Preparation for duplicating TDR to requesting L1s - Enterprise TDR
items.description: This feature prepares the TDR application for deployment across other L1 organizations while maintaining data integrity and separation from existing VCDS GP data. It focuses on identifying dependencies, permissions, and workflow adjustments required to safely replicate the solution for other L1 ASCs.

items.title: Auto-Generate Title

items.title: Container — Generic Details

items.title: Container — Clearance Specific Details
items.description: This is where users can include the specific details, based on the clearance type they selected. For example, a specific L2 may require users to include their XYZ details. This is where they would do it. The specific details for the users will be outlined per the generated template. Templates will be editable for admins with the specific admin role

items.title: Container — Attachments
items.description: This is where users are instructed to include the required attachment, based on the general and specific details The attachments should be uploaded using a flow

items.title: Container — Approvals
items.description: The user / approvers can see the approvals needed to complete this clearance, along with their status If a user is an approver, they can sign their respective sections ** IMPORTANT: This screen should only be visible if the clearance has already been submitted. items.assigned: Martin, Perry VCDS Gp HQ VCEMD QG Gp Defence365
